Title: End Semester Examination Schedule Released
Content: The timetable for Semester 5 Final External Examinations has been uploaded. Practical exams commence on Dec 15.

Title: Mandatory Attendance Condonation Fee Notice
Content: Students with attendance between 65% and 74% must submit medical records for condonation approval by Dec 05.

Title: Semester 5 Tuition Fee Clearances
Content: All pending dues for Semester 5 must be settled before hall ticket distribution. Check Accounts Section.

Title: Smart India Hackathon 2025 Shortlisted Teams
Content: Hearty congratulations to the 12 shortlisted teams representing IFHE in the national grand finale.

Title: Urgent: Library Overdue Books Return Window
Content: Late penalty waiver active until Dec 10 for all overdue monograph returns.

Title: Campus Recruitment Drive - Top Product Companies
Content: Phase 1 placements drive for pre-final years begins in January 2026. Register on the CDC portal.

Title: CSE Dept Seminar on Large Language Models
Content: Guest lecture by Dr. S. Rao from Google DeepMind on scalable alignment and agent architectures.

Title: ECE Workshop on Embedded IoT and FPGA
Content: Hands-on two-day boot camp with ARM Cortex boards in Electronics Laboratory 3.

Title: EEE Industrial Visit to 400kV Substation
Content: Site visit scheduled on Saturday for power systems students. Bus departs at 8:30 AM from campus.

Title: AI & Data Science Hackathon Registration
Content: 24-hour algorithmic prediction sprint sponsored by industry partners. Cash prize worth 1 Lakh.
